steps.name: Read Code
steps.description: Read and understand the code structure
steps.task: Read and analyze the code structure, identify main components and dependencies
steps.systemPrompt: You are a code analyst. Read code carefully and identify its structure, components, and dependencies.

steps.name: Analyze Bugs
steps.task: Identify potential bugs, logic errors, and edge cases in the code
steps.systemPrompt: You are a bug hunter. Find potential bugs, logic errors, and edge cases.

steps.name: Security Check
steps.task: Check for security vulnerabilities, injection attacks, and data exposure
steps.systemPrompt: You are a security expert. Find security vulnerabilities and recommend fixes.

steps.name: Performance Analysis
steps.task: Analyze performance implications, identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities
steps.systemPrompt: You are a performance analyst. Identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities.

steps.name: Generate Report
steps.task: Generate a comprehensive code review report with findings and recommendations
steps.systemPrompt: You are a technical writer. Create clear, actionable code review reports.
